title: Complex-Script Existing-Text Editing
acceptance: Arabic-script existing text is classified separately from generic complex scripts and enters a shaped fixed-box path.
Apply is blocked until a local imported font validates coverage for the current replacement text.
Mixed Arabic/Latin/digit/punctuation content is reordered with a Unicode bidi implementation and shaped with HarfBuzz.
The PDF writer embeds the validated font through MuPDF's Identity-H CID font path and emits shaped glyph IDs rather than unshaped Unicode character operators.
Shaped lines carry ActualText with the original logical Unicode so copy/search semantics are not replaced by visual glyph order.
Explicit bidi controls, unrelated shaping scripts, missing glyphs and fixed-box overflow fail closed.
Arabic bulk Find/Replace and cross-paragraph layout-aware reflow remain disabled until they have separate evidence.
No persistent schema or executable-version cut occurs in P14.
